inputs.checklistItemText: Trees not shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities, preventing clearance verification
inputs.question: Looking at Sheet 31, the landscape plan: Are both the overhead electric lines (OHE) AND the tree locations clearly shown on the same drawing so that clearances between tree locations and the OHE line can be visually assessed?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/visibility question—whether both OHE lines and trees are shown together on the same sheet—which is a prerequisite check before any clearance measurement can occur. This is sheet-discovery and feature-presence verification, not a measurement of actual clearance distance.
